receiver_local_lift_locus.retained_open: same U_BT retained by 36-09CM/CS, with t!=0 and the named root functions nonzero
receiver_local_lift_locus.source_binding: 36-09CM states that this degree-32 five-root cover is equivalent to the BT normalized four-square model on the retained open, with w0=B*t, w1=R, w2=S, w3=Zminus/A, w4=Zplus/A.
receiver_local_lift_locus.receiver_admissible_local_point_used_her: a Q_v-point of the actual retained BT/full-cover local receiver locus, hence a tuple (y_v,w0_v,...,w4_v) satisfying all five equations

cs_class_restriction.reason: pushout of the neutral H^1 class is neutral

cq_local_tate_pairing_on_target.reason: the right pairing argument is the neutral class, so every coordinate Hilbert symbol has second argument a square

required_place_result_for_this_evaluatio.why_general_inventory_stays_open: This empty set is specific to the CS evaluation after restriction to the actual receiver lift locus. It does not complete the broader LIT-WF02/Poitou-Tate required-place package for other possible dual classes or Brauer evaluations.

adelic_consequence.for_every_receiver_admissible_adelic_tup: every local CS pairing invariant is zero
adelic_consequence.this_is_not_global_global_reciprocity_re: The vanishing is stronger and pointwise: the dual class itself is zero on every actual local lift. No global reciprocity argument is needed.

structural_diagnosis.explanation: The Kummer class Delta5 measures failure of a base point y_v to lift to the five-root torsor. Receiver-admissible local points are precisely points for which such a lift is already supplied, so Delta5 and every quotient/pushout of it vanish there.

route_result.next_leaf_semantics: Search/build an evaluation whose class is defined on actual receiver local points but is not the Kummer obstruction to the very five-root lift those points already possess. Candidate shapes are a source-bound secondary torsor/quotient extension or an explicit Brauer class with point-dependent local invariant. Reuse existing assets only after exact type/source binding.
